reviews.title: I want to use a second phone as a…
reviews.body: I want to use a second phone as a backup so I bought & £5 Lebara Mobile SIM in a shop. It said 5GB data, 1000 mins & 100 texts. I put the SIM in the phone, typed in the voucher code etc. Tried to make a call, it said I had no credit. I never managed to make a call or text anyone. I could call their customer services who were very polite but completely useless. They said perhaps the data was being used by background processes, however, the phone hasn't left the house & is set to prioritise WiFi. I explained this & that I believe the data usage was erroneous.  I also explained that I was prepared to write off the data, but, if I couldn't use the minutes/texts I bought I would destroy the SIM, write this review & never use their services again. As they insisted there's  nothing they could do, the SIM is now in two pieces in the bin & review has been written.

reviews.title: ​I order a SIM on 26th
reviews.body:
​I order a SIM on 26th, in the offer they said it will be with me next working day. After waiting for days and wasting both time and money relying on a SIM that never showed up, I contacted customer support again today to request a refund. Instead of offering a real solution, the agent simply asked me to wait again until Monday!
​Only after I firmly insisted on a refund did they process it, claiming it will take another 3 to 5 working days to reach my account.
​unfortunately, Lebara completely failed to deliver on their delivery promises and repeatedly misled me about when the SIM would arrive. Extremely disappointing customer service and experience—I definitely won't recommend them
